verdict.rationale: The only hint of versioning is that feature docs sit under a `/v1/` path, and there is a platform changelog. That suggests a versioned major API generation but does not document a versioning scheme. Nothing in the pack describes a deprecation policy, and no OpenAPI spec was found at any probed path. missing for 10: explicit API versioning documentation, a documented deprecation policy or timeline, a published versioned API spec (OpenAPI probes returned 404), independent corroboration of version stability.
